item.title: ‘Heartland’ Review: Jessica Chastain’s Nashville Mystery Is A Maddeningly Contrived Mess
item.description: Picture this. A screenwriter walks into a room full of studio executives and pitches a thriller about a rising country singer who disappears in Nashville. The police are inexplicably indifferent, her family is getting nowhere, and so who do they enlist to play detective? Her aunt, a disgraced country music star whose career imploded two decades earlier, who returns home to kick up some dust and play amateur snoop. Oh, and she’s played by Jessica Chastain , an Academy Award-winning actress who, for reasons that become increasingly difficult to fathom, has agreed to star in this thing. Continue reading ‘Heartland’ Review: Jessica Chastain’s Nashville Mystery Is A Maddeningly Contrived Mess at The Playlist.
